test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All T are F.

II. Some P are T.

**Conclusions:**

I. No F is P.

II. Some F are P is a possibility.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7acac9105d5f6f61d371d83e8c0ce9d0629b45e334f354e92e1364f39f57a3b5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No F is P → False (As All T are F and Some P are T so, No F is P is false)

II. Some F are P is a possibility. → False (When given conclusion is true then the possibility given is not followed. So, the possibility is not followed)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follows".**
